name: SEO 02 – Blog writer (research, links, diagrams, draft)

parameters.content:
## 1. Pick a keyword
Runs on schedule or manually. Takes the best `ready` keyword from the **Keywords** tab (or `KEYWORD_OVERRIDE` in Config).

assignments.name: BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION
assignments.value: Describe your business, your offer and your ideal customer here.

assignments.name: BRAND_VOICE
assignments.value: Friendly expert. Plain language, concrete examples, no hype, no jargon without explanation.

parameters.content:
## 2. Research (separate from writing)
Internal-link inventory from your sitemap, live SERP, competitor headings + the sources they cite (external links), and who links to the #1 page (backlink prospects).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ keyword: $json.keyword, location_name: $json.location_name, language_name: $json.language_name, depth: 10, people_also_ask_click_depth: 2 }]) }}
={{ JSON.stringify([{ target: $json.serp_results[0] ? $json.serp_results[0].url : "", mode: "one_per_domain", limit: 50, filters: ["dofollow", "=", true], order_by: ["domain_from_rank,desc"] }]) }}

parameters.content:
## 3. Write
Claude plans first (outline, internal + external link plan, Mermaid diagrams, FAQ), then writes. Links are restricted to real sitemap pages and researched sources.

## 4. Quality gate + publish
Removes invented/broken links, renders diagrams to images (mermaid.ink), adds FAQ schema, saves to **Posts**, marks the keyword `drafted`, logs backlink prospects. Enable the WordPress node if you publish there.
